baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural subject governs the doing at word 4 and the witness predicate at word 6, while the believers at word 5 are the affected party.
baseline_models.mechanism: The same group brings an act into being and remains directly present to see it. Witnessing is contemporaneous participation in their own deed, not detached later testimony.

activation_trace.role: Bringing an act into being identifies the plural group as producers of the event they watch.
Presence with direct seeing binds their gaze to the scene their own action produces.

changed_reading.before: They happen to observe something being done to believers.
changed_reading.after: They knowingly remain present as agents of the very treatment they observe.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The deed root at word 4 and the witness root at word 6 are predicated of one subject, allowing conduct and testimony to coincide.
baseline_models.mechanism: Their conduct is not only an event but a visible, knowledgeable disclosure of who they are. The doers thereby furnish evidence against themselves.

activation_trace.role: Conduct carrying praise or blame supplies the morally legible quality of the deed.
Knowledgeable testimony turns what they know firsthand into evidence rather than mere sight.
A visible sign that reveals a condition lets the conduct itself bear witness.

changed_reading.before: Witnesses are only people who can later describe the scene.
changed_reading.after: The perpetrators' visible conduct is already knowledgeable testimony, making them self-incriminating witnesses.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The affected party at word 5 is named by the security-and-assent root rather than by a neutral social label.
baseline_models.mechanism: The action reaches people precisely as bearers of settled trust and confirming assent. It therefore places an inward orientation of security into an exposed social relation.

activation_trace.role: Causing something to undergo an action supplies the pressure exerted on the affected group.
Settled security and trust identify the human state placed under external pressure.
Trusting assent makes conviction, not merely group membership, salient in the object relation.

changed_reading.before: Believers is simply the name of the victim group.
changed_reading.after: What is acted upon is embodied trust and assent, exposed without ceasing to define its bearers.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The act at word 4 is coupled to witnesses at word 6, so making an event and controlling its visible account can be read together.
baseline_models.mechanism: A form-distant fabrication branch activates the possibility that the group stages not only a deed but a public account of the deed. Their own witnessing then serves the display they have contrived; this is an exploratory activation, not a lexical gloss of the verb form.

activation_trace.role: Contrived fabrication supplies the tentative staging or narrative-control dimension of the deed.
Visible expression as a witnessing tongue supplies an account that displays its maker.
The witnessing sign lets the staged scene advertise a claimed meaning beyond the physical act.

changed_reading.before: The clause reports only a concrete treatment observed by its agents.
changed_reading.after: It may also expose a spectacle whose makers try to manufacture and certify its public meaning.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding posture turns the focus witnesses into stationed operators. Fixed sitting, watchful waiting, and the same group's ongoing action make the gaze part of the apparatus that sustains the treatment.

activation_trace.role: Produced action prevents the seated group from being reduced to neutral bystanders.
Direct presence supplies the eyewitness state that the preceding posture spatially fixes.
Sitting and remaining fixed in a place supplies the durable station from which the act is supervised.
Holding back from action exposes the moral passivity that coexists with their active responsibility.
Sitting in watch or ambush turns observation into an operational monitoring role.

structural_cues: The adjacent clauses repeat the same plural subject and an over-or-upon relation.
A fixed nominal posture is followed by a witness predicate while an active verb remains assigned to the same group.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fixed sitting, abstention, and watchful stationing; I add the arrow that remaining over the scene enables and supervises the ongoing act. A live alternative is merely simultaneous spectatorship without an operational role.

changed_reading.before: The perpetrators are present eyewitnesses to their own action.
changed_reading.after: Their stationary watching is itself a mode of participation: supervision and nonintervention help the action continue.

context_deltas.mechanism: The unspecified treatment becomes an engineered assay: a cut channel contains fuel, fire applies pressure, and watchers inspect whether settled trust will yield. The believers are treated as human material whose inward assent is forced toward an observable result.

activation_trace.role: Bringing an act into being supplies the deliberate construction and operation of the trial.
Settled security and trust supply the inward condition placed under coercive pressure.
Direct observation supplies the monitoring needed to read the trial's attempted result.
A long, deep cut supplies the containing channel and material geometry of the ordeal.
Fuel as the material of burning makes the harm maintained and provisioned rather than momentary.
Testing metal or a person supplies the assay mechanism applied to the believers' constancy.
Burning and blackening supply the literal heat through which the attempted test operates.

structural_cues: Before the focus, the sequence assembles trench, fire, fuel, seated operators, and witnesses.
After the focus, the believers recur as the affected party of a verb whose branches join testing and burning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a cut channel, fuel, observation, and a branch joining human testing to burning; I infer that heat is used to force inward trust into an outwardly readable response. The live alternative is that the testing root names persecution broadly without a metallurgical mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The verse leaves the harmful treatment materially unspecified.
changed_reading.after: It depicts a coercive experiment in which engineered heat tries to make the believers' inward security visibly fail.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next verse supplies a sole grievance: trusting assent directed to God. Disapproval passes into punishment, so the focus action reads as enforcement against allegiance, while witnessing becomes inspection for conformity or recantation.

activation_trace.role: Trusting assent identifies the conviction for which the affected group is singled out.
Testimony from knowledge supplies the inspectors' capacity to certify compliance or refusal.
Censuring and finding fault supplies the evaluative judgment preceding coercion.
Punishment following disapproval supplies the transition from ideological rejection to inflicted action.
The verbal act of trusting assent identifies the prohibited commitment as active, not merely inherited.
Worship and the worshiped one locate the believers' allegiance outside the persecutors' authority.

structural_cues: An exclusive construction in the next verse makes belief the only stated ground of resentment.
The focus first names the people by belief and the next verse restates belief as their action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies censure becoming punishment, active assent, and worship; I add the arrow that the witnessed treatment polices allegiance and watches for renunciation. A live alternative is retaliatory hatred with no intended compliance check.

changed_reading.before: The action targets a group called believers.
changed_reading.after: The action punishes an allegiance the persecutors cannot absorb, and their gaze monitors whether conviction will submit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The perpetrators' local gaze is bracketed by a witness-and-witnessed field and then by testimony over every knowable thing, finally by complete encirclement in knowledge. Those who watch from above are themselves watched and contained.

activation_trace.role: Local presence with seeing supplies the perpetrators' limited observational position.
The paired field of one present to see and one seen opens a witness structure larger than the focus group.
Comprehensive testimony from knowledge supplies a counter-witness not confined to the perpetrators' viewpoint.
Total inclusion and completion make the later witnessing exhaustive rather than selective.
Complete enclosure in knowledge places the human observers inside a field they cannot escape or edit.

structural_cues: The witness root appears before the focus as a pair and after it with a different, comprehensive subject.
The focus group's over-position is later answered by language of being surrounded.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies layered witness expressions, totality, and knowledgeable enclosure; I infer a counter-surveillance topology in which the watchers become the watched. A live alternative is that the repetitions independently assert omniscience without spatially reversing the focus gaze.

changed_reading.before: The perpetrators appear to control who sees and what the scene means.
changed_reading.after: Their gaze is only an inner layer of a larger witness field that turns the observers into observed evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's human doing is echoed by an intensive divine doer acting according to will. The echo preserves human responsibility while denying that the witnessed human action is the final or self-sufficient agency in the sequence.

activation_trace.role: Bringing about the focus act supplies real human agency and therefore responsibility.
The repeated action branch under an intensive agent supplies the higher-scale agency that answers the focus doers.
Will and volition supply the governing orientation attached to the later, intensive action.

structural_cues: The action root and an indefinite relative construction recur, but the subject changes from a human plural to an intensive singular agent.
The later echo follows promises of grasp, beginning again, forgiveness, and love.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the formal action echo and volition; I infer a hierarchy that limits the perpetrators' apparent closure without assigning their cruelty directly to divine causation. A live alternative is a moral comparison of two kinds of agency rather than causal containment.

changed_reading.before: The perpetrators' effective action seems to close the believers' horizon.
changed_reading.after: Their responsible action remains real but is not ultimate; the repeated root opens a larger agency capable of reversal.

context_deltas.mechanism: In the focus, believers occupy the affected relation of someone else's raw doing. Later, the same believing identity becomes the subject of intentional work directed toward repair rather than toward persons. The sequence restores agency and distinguishes effective action from ethically constructive work.

activation_trace.role: Bare production of an act supplies the perpetrators' effective but ethically unspecified doing.
Trusting assent anchors the people whose grammatical role will reverse from affected party to actor.
Renewed trusting assent preserves identity across the shift from being acted upon to acting.
Intentional action and work supply the believers' recovered purposeful agency.
Soundness opposed to corruption gives that recovered work a reparative ethical direction.

structural_cues: The believers shift from the affected relation in the focus to the subject position in the later clause.
The action lexeme changes when agency changes, and the later work takes sound deeds rather than people as its field.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the subject-object reversal and distinct branches for bare doing, intentional work, and repair; I infer an ethical contrast between coercive efficacy and constructive agency. A live alternative is ordinary synonym variation with no designed lexical distinction.

changed_reading.before: Believers appear only as objects of what powerful others do.
changed_reading.after: Their identity persists into purposeful, reparative agency, so the persecutors' act never acquires ownership of their story.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later denial is activated as concealment and false attribution. Read against direct witnessing, disbelief becomes less an absence of information than an attempt to cover or redescribe what the deniers' own presence has made known.

activation_trace.role: Testifying from knowledge supplies firsthand information that makes simple ignorance unavailable.
Covering truth supplies an active suppression response to what witnessing has disclosed.
Contradiction of truth supplies the later stance set against firsthand knowledge.
Attributing falsehood to a thing or speaker supplies the attempt to transfer unreliability onto the testimony.

structural_cues: A later adversarial plural is introduced by a contrastive turn, but explicit grammatical coreference with the focus group is not supplied.
Knowledge-bearing witness language precedes language of sustained denial.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies firsthand testimony, truth-covering, and false attribution; I infer that the later denial exposes willful management of known evidence. The live alternative is that the later deniers are a broader class rather than the same historical actors.

changed_reading.before: Their witnessing merely increases the amount they know about the event.
changed_reading.after: Witnessing makes denial culpably active: truth must be covered or reassigned as false precisely because it was seen.

context_deltas.mechanism: The witnessed act acquires a possible afterlife as repeatedly renewed report, gathered recitation, writing surface, and guarded memory. The perpetrators can control the immediate spectacle but not the later circulation and preservation of its testimony.

activation_trace.role: The articulate or visible witness supplies testimony capable of leaving the original scene through expression.
A sign that reveals a condition supplies evidence able to persist beyond a living observer.
Speech renewed as report supplies temporal retransmission of a past witnessed event.
Becoming the talk of people reverses the watchers into subjects of public memory.
Gathering and collection supply a form in which dispersed witness material can be held together.
Reading and recitation supply repeated public reactivation of the testimony.
A broad writing surface supplies durable inscription as the material analogy for retained evidence.
Guarding and watching over something supply protection against loss or erasure.
Fixing the preserved thing in memory supplies endurance beyond the immediate eyewitnesses.

structural_cues: The later sequence moves through report, recited discourse, a tablet, and preservation.
The focus names witnesses inside the discourse that the closing sequence characterizes as gathered and guarded.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies renewed report, recitation, a writing surface, and preservation; I infer that the focus event participates in a durable evidence chain. The live alternative is that the closing preservation applies to the discourse as a whole without specially thematizing this witnessed scene.

changed_reading.before: The scene is known by the perpetrators who are physically there.
changed_reading.after: Its testimony can leave them behind, recur as public report, and remain guarded after their gaze has ended.

context_deltas.mechanism: Two made environments oppose each other. A deep cut is provisioned as a fire-place under exposed surveillance; later, a sheltered garden stands over freely running water whose river also cuts the earth. What humans make around believers is materially answered by a protective, life-carrying channel.

activation_trace.role: Making an act supplies the human production of an environment imposed on believers.
The security-bearing people anchor both the imposed environment and its eventual reversal.
The elongated deep cut supplies the first channel, made to contain destructive heat.
A designated fire-place supplies the destructive contents and function assigned to the first channel.
A garden sheltered by vegetation supplies protective enclosure in place of exposed spectacle.
Free flow supplies the life-bearing movement that replaces maintained combustion.
A river cutting earth with running water supplies the answering channel and reverses the trench's use.

structural_cues: The focus is preceded by an over-position around fire and followed by an under-position for flowing water.
Believers connect the destructive apparatus before the focus to the garden-and-river outcome after it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two earth-cutting channels, opposed contents, exposure, shelter, and above-below placement; I infer a designed material reversal of the environment imposed on believers. The live alternative is a general punishment-reward contrast without a channel-by-channel correspondence.

changed_reading.before: The perpetrators' engineered setting seems to define the believers' material world.
changed_reading.after: Their fire channel is provisional: a sheltered water channel answers and outlasts the environment they made.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it joins a non-dominant sky-to-mark mapping with cheek-brand, fire-brand, blackening, heat-mark, and witness-sign branches across distant domains. It remains anchored in the focus act upon believers and in the focus witness branch that permits a visible sign to testify. Render it only as a material analogy in which violence leaves evidence; do not claim that the sky, trench, bodies, or tablet are lexical equivalents.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The action at word 4 is done in relation to believers at word 5, while the witness predicate at word 6 can denote a sign that visibly discloses a state.

activation_trace.role: Causing something to undergo action supplies the production of a physical trace on the affected party.
A visible sign that reveals condition permits material traces to join people in bearing witness.
The non-dominant mapping supplies a conspicuous brand by which a thing becomes known.
A brand placed on the cheek links the cut form to bodily marking.
Kindled fire together with branding by fire supplies the instrument that makes violence visible.
Burning and blackening supply the altered surface as an evidentiary residue.
Heat changing color supplies the final material link between burning and a legible mark.
Guarding a thing supplies the inference that the produced evidence cannot simply be erased.

changed_reading.before: Only the seated perpetrators count as witnesses to the act.
changed_reading.after: The burning may leave material signs that out-testify its agents: the violence writes evidence into what it changes.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the victory inventory preserves both rescue and death-or-destruction branches. It remains anchored in a focus where believers undergo an action and in the earlier lethal branch. Render it as a reversal of who controls the meaning of an outcome, not as a universal claim that death is automatically victory.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The perpetrators act upon believers at words 4-5, but the focus does not grant the perpetrators authority to determine what that action ultimately means.

activation_trace.role: Bringing an act into being supplies the perpetrators' attempted control over the event's outcome.
Trusting assent anchors the identity whose meaning may survive a lethal action.
Taking life supplies the apparent terminal success sought by the violent apparatus.
Attaining good and escaping supplies the ordinary positive outcome promised to believers.
Victory through death or destruction supplies the paradoxical route by which lethal force can fail semantically.

changed_reading.before: If the perpetrators complete the lethal act, they determine its success.
changed_reading.after: Even lethal completion can be detached from their intended victory and become the believers' escape from their control.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it depends on the packet's rare non-dominant mapping from the focus action root to parental causation and nurture. It remains formally anchored to the exact focus action citation and gains a contextual counterimage from repair, nurture, and love. Render it only as an ethical contrast or anti-nurture image, never as the lexical meaning of the focus verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The action at word 4 is the causal hinge: the perpetrators bring about something in relation to believers, while a non-dominant mapped branch asks what kind of causing this is.

activation_trace.role: Parental causation, correction, and nurture supply a deliberately form-distant ethical counterimage to the perpetrators' causing.
Repair, upbringing, and completion reinforce constructive causation as the opposing mode of power.
Love and affection give the constructive counterimage a relational rather than merely efficient character.
The same non-dominant nurture branch under the later action echo contrasts two radically different images of causation.

changed_reading.before: The focus contrasts only weak victims with effective perpetrators.
changed_reading.after: The perpetrators' effectiveness can be seen as anti-generative power: causing severed from the nurture, repair, and love that make power life-giving.

strongest_changes: The adjacent seated posture turns eyewitnessing into stationary supervision and culpable nonintervention.
Trench, fuel, and testing-by-fire revise an unspecified act into a coercive assay meant to make inward trust visibly yield.
The witness field expands around the perpetrators, turning those who watch into watched and preserved evidence.
Believers move from being acted upon to purposeful reparative agency, while fire-channel and water-channel images preserve a material reversal.
summary.what_was_special: The focus is a hinge where agency and visibility repeatedly reverse. The perpetrators are simultaneously doers, supervisors, witnesses, and evidence; believers are simultaneously exposed objects of coercion and persistent agents of trust; later context refuses to let the local watchers control either the record or the outcome. The fire-assay, ideological-policing, counter-witness, restored-agency, and channel-reversal readings remain coexisting mechanisms rather than one merged interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The assay reading is materially coherent, but the testing branch may function broadly rather than metallurgically.
The later deniers and narrated armies need not be grammatically identical with the focus perpetrators, so the evidence-chain reading remains abductive.
The marking network and the non-dominant nurture mapping are worth preserving as outliers but should not be promoted into direct lexical claims.
